_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'QUALITY AUDIT REPORT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.05.

f01_Area_Audited.label: Area Audited
f01_Area_Audited.guidance: Specific processes, documentation, deliverables, or quality procedures evaluated.

f02_Good_Practices_from_Similar_Projects.label: Good Practices from Similar Projects
f02_Good_Practices_from_Similar_Projects.guidance: High-performing practices, techniques, and benchmarks identified during audit.

f03_Areas_for_Improvement.label: Areas for Improvement
f03_Areas_for_Improvement.guidance: Gaps, performance deviations, and recommended procedural optimizations.

f04_Deficiencies_or_Defects.label: Deficiencies or Defects
f04_Deficiencies_or_Defects.guidance: Recorded defects, non-compliance items, and assigned corrective actions.

f05_Implementation_Tracking_of_Approved_.label: Implementation Tracking of Approved Changes
f05_Implementation_Tracking_of_Approved_.guidance: Status of previously approved corrective actions, preventive actions, and defect repairs.

f06_Information_to_Share_with_Other_Proj.section: Information to Share with Other Projects
f06_Information_to_Share_with_Other_Proj.label: Information to Share with Other Projects
f06_Information_to_Share_with_Other_Proj.guidance: Valuable organizational insights, lessons, and quality benchmarks to disseminate.

f07_Comments.label: Comments
f07_Comments.guidance: General observations, auditor notes, and executive summary.
